original_text: –Biotechnologyis simply defined as the exploitation of biological processes for industrial and other purposes–Humans also unintentionally caused–the evolution of antibiotic-resistant bacteria–the evolution of pesticide-resistant pests–the loss of species through habitat loss and global climate change.–Could this have been avoided?
explanation: This slide defines biotechnology as the exploitation of biological processes for industrial and other purposes. It notes that human activities have also unintentionally caused negative environmental and biological consequences. These include: the evolution of antibiotic-resistant bacteria, the evolution of pesticide-resistant pests, and the loss of species through habitat destruction and global climate change. It ends by asking whether these outcomes could have been avoided.
